requirement:
# Study requirement, car C1 (the car shown to participants): proportional_braking + yolov5s.
# C1-C4 differ only in the two "performed by" names (docs/paper/experiment_design.md).
MAINTAIN "Pedestrian Safety"
    by
        "Pedestrian Check" using "Perception Module"
            operationalized as
                "Detect Pedestrian" performed by "yolov5s"
                taking input "image" producing output "pedestrian detection confidence" & "pedestrian detection flag"
    followed by
        "braking" using "braking module"
            operationalized as
                "Bring down throttle" & "Apply Brakes" if "pedestrian detection flag=True" performed by "proportional_braking"
                taking input "pedestrian detection flag" producing output "Braking Status Flag"
    in scenario where
        "A pedestrian trying to cross the street."
    assuming "fog_density <= 50" & "sun_altitude_angle >= 0" & "initial_separation_m >= 15" & "pedestrian_speed_mps <= 3" & "pedestrian on foot"
    ensuring "resume_within_s <= 10" & "braking is smooth unless an emergency stop is needed"
scenario_text: A pedestrian trying to cross the street.

scene.crossing_trigger_meaning: 0 = meet the car; > 0 = step out when the car is this close (m)

worst_phenotype: A { pedestrian : Adult } wearing a {dress : Light} dress trying to cross road from { direction : RL } with the car { approach_distance_m : 20 } m away on a day with fog density {fog_density : 0}, sun altitude {sun_altitude_angle : 60} deg, road wetness {wetness : 80}, rain {precipitation : 0}, cloud {cloudiness : 50}, occlusion {occlusion : 0}, walking at least {pedestrian_min_speed_mps : 2.0} m/s, stepping out at {crossing_trigger_m : 0} m
